=LET(raw, A2:E1000, filtered, FILTER(raw, INDEX(raw,,3)>100), sorted, SORT(filtered, 3, FALSE), IF(ROWS(sorted)>0, MAP(SEQUENCE(MIN(10, ROWS(sorted))), LAMBDA(i, INDEX(sorted, i, 1))), "No results"))
=LET(data, FILTER(A1:Z1000, INDEX(A1:Z1000,,2)="Active"), stats, BYROW(data, LAMBDA(r, SUM(INDEX(r,,4), INDEX(r,,5), INDEX(r,,6), INDEX(r,,7), INDEX(r,,8)))), ranked, SORT(HSTACK(data, stats), COLUMNS(data)+1, FALSE), TAKE(ranked, MIN(50, ROWS(ranked))))
=LET(v0, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,1)>0), v1, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,2)>0), v2, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,3)>0), v3, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,4)>0), v4, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,5)>0), v5, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,6)>0), v6, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,7)>0), v7, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,8)>0), v8, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,9)>0), v9, FILTER(A1:Z100, INDEX(A1:Z100,,10)>0), v9)
=IFERROR(XLOOKUP(XLOOKUP(A1, B1:B100, C1:C100), D1:D100, SORT(FILTER(E1:G100, F1:F100>0))), IFERROR(VLOOKUP(INDEX(MATCH(A1, H1:H100, 0), I1:I100), J1:L100, 3, FALSE), SUMPRODUCT(M1:M100, N1:N100)))
=LET(a, SEQUENCE(100), b, MAP(a, LAMBDA(x, x*x)), c, SCAN(0, b, LAMBDA(acc, v, acc+v)), d, MAP(c, LAMBDA(v, ROUND(v/MAX(c)*100, 2))), e, FILTER(HSTACK(a, b, c, d), INDEX(HSTACK(a, b, c, d),,4)>50), SORT(e, 4, FALSE))
=REDUCE("", SEQUENCE(20), LAMBDA(acc, i, LET(row, INDEX(A1:Z100, i, 0), score, SUM(INDEX(row,,4), INDEX(row,,5), INDEX(row,,6)), name, INDEX(row,,1), IF(acc="", name, acc&", "&name))))
=LET(tbl, A1:H500, col1, INDEX(tbl,,1), col3, INDEX(tbl,,3), filt, FILTER(tbl, col1>AVERAGE(col1)), grp, UNIQUE(INDEX(filt,,2)), stats, MAP(grp, LAMBDA(g, LET(sub, FILTER(filt, INDEX(filt,,2)=g), HSTACK(g, ROWS(sub), AVERAGE(INDEX(sub,,3)), MEDIAN(INDEX(sub,,3)))))), SORT(stats, 3, FALSE))
=BYROW(A1:D100, LAMBDA(row, IF(SUM(row)>0, AVERAGE(row), 0)))
